plugin.note: Use level 146 araxytes where possible; avoid level 96 araxytes because they have a worse drop table and cannot spawn Dreadborn Araxytes. Cannon plus Venator bow is the main fast normal-task method; bring extended anti-venom+, seed box, herb sack, and bracelets of slaughter.

requirements: Spider cave teleport is useful for reaching the Morytania Spider Cave entrance
mechanics: Araxytes use melee and can inflict venom starting at 6 damage. Maintain venom immunity for the full trip.
Level 146 araxytes are the recommended normal-task target because they have the better drop table and are the only regular araxytes that can spawn Dreadborn Araxytes.

The main chamber mixes level 96 and level 146 araxytes. Three on-task caves sit east of the main chamber: the north cave is single-way with level 146 araxytes, the east cave is multi-way with level 96 araxytes, and the south cave is multi-way with level 146 araxytes.
Dreadborn Araxyte can only spawn from level 146 araxytes and can launch venom pools that can deal up to 50 damage.

methods.name: General task setup
methods.description: Use the Morytania Spider Cave for all Araxyte tasks. Bring extended anti-venom+, food, a seed box, herb sack, and alchemy support for stackable and alchable drops.
steps: Teleport to the Morytania Spider Cave entrance with a spider cave teleport when available.
Maintain venom immunity before engaging araxytes.
Prioritise level 146 araxytes for normal task completion.
Pick up Araxyte venom sacks and other valuable stackable or alchemy drops.
Use bracelets of slaughter if extending the profitable task is desired.
notes: The cave is far from a bank, so inventory-extending items reduce banking.
At high kill rates or when cannoning, set attack options to right-click if loot or venom sacks become hard to pick up quickly.

methods.name: Level 146 Araxytes
methods.description: Use level 146 araxytes as the default normal-task target because they are stronger, more rewarding, and can spawn Dreadborn Araxytes.
steps: Use the northern single-way level 146 cave when controlled single combat is preferred.
Use the southern multi-way level 146 cave when using cannon or multi-target weapons.
Keep venom immunity active and kill Dreadborn Araxytes when they spawn.
notes: Only level 146 araxytes can spawn the Dreadborn Araxyte superior.
This is the recommended normal Araxyte task path.

methods.name: Cannon plus Venator bow
methods.description: Use a dwarf multicannon with Venator bow in multicombat areas for fast normal Araxyte task completion.
steps: Set up a dwarf multicannon in the south multi-way level 146 cave.
Use Venator bow to bounce between araxytes; level 146 araxytes have 2x2 hitboxes, which makes barrage methods less useful.
Keep the cannon loaded and move only as needed to collect valuable drops.
Refresh extended anti-venom+ before it expires.
notes: Cannoning is still profitable because Araxyte tasks have valuable stackable drops and Araxyte venom sacks.
This is the main fast normal-task method for LLM routing and plugin recommendations.

methods.name: Avoid level 96 Araxytes
methods.description: Avoid level 96 araxytes except when a specific low-level or barrage setup intentionally targets them.
steps: Do not use the east multi-way cave as the default task location because it contains level 96 araxytes.
Avoid the mixed main chamber when level 146-only caves are available.
Only consider level 96 araxytes for a deliberate 1x1 barrage setup.
notes: Level 96 araxytes have a worse drop table.
Level 96 araxytes cannot spawn Dreadborn Araxytes.

methods.name: Araxxor boss alternative
methods.description: Araxxor can be killed on an Araxyte task when choosing profit over task speed.
steps: Use Araxxor only when slower boss kills are desired instead of fast normal-task completion.
Bring Araxxor-specific inventory and equipment rather than the normal Araxyte cannon setup.
Use a strong crush weapon for Araxxor.
Maintain any Slayer boost if using a spiders task to boost from 87 Slayer.
notes: Araxxor is more profitable but much slower than normal Araxytes.
A strong crush weapon is highly recommended for Araxxor.

styleOptions.name: Ranged cannon

styleOptions.name: Melee
